column_mapping.note: Jobs are stored as rows in the already-cached campaigns table tagged is_job=true. Job applications reuse the already-cached applications table (its campaign_id points at a job/campaign row). Banners are stored as a JSON array inside a single already-cached platform_settings row (key='home_banners'). Providers MAP db columns back to the exact keys the screens expect, so NO screen changes are needed.

jobs_field_to_campaigns_column.title: title
jobs_field_to_campaigns_column.payment_amount: per_creator_payout (provider returns BOTH keys: also expose 'payment_amount')
jobs_field_to_campaigns_column.max_slots: total_slots (campaigns.total_slots is NOT NULL DEFAULT 1; when job max_slots is null store a sentinel and expose max_slots=null back; see steps)
jobs_field_to_campaigns_column.status: status (jobs use active/closed/draft; campaigns CHECK forbids 'closed' -> SQL must relax the campaigns status CHECK to also allow 'closed')
jobs_field_to_campaigns_column.created_by: brand_id (campaigns.brand_id is NOT NULL and FK->users; set to the admin/current user id)
jobs_field_to_campaigns_column.is_job marker: new column is_job boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false

job_application_field_to_applications_co.job_id: campaign_id (points at the campaigns row that is_job=true)
job_application_field_to_applications_co.status: status (jobs use applied/submitted/approved/rejected; applications CHECK forbids applied/submitted -> SQL must relax applications status CHECK to also allow 'applied' and 'submitted')

column_mapping.banners_storage: platform_settings row key='home_banners', value = JSON string of an array of banner objects. Each object keeps keys: id (generated uuid string), title, image_url, link_type, link_campaign_id, link_page, is_visible, sort_order, created_at, updated_at. Provider parses/serializes this JSON.
